line.guide:
LINE setup, step by step (all web steps, about 10 minutes):
 1. https://developers.line.biz/console/ -> log in -> create a Provider (any name).
 2. Create a channel of type 'Messaging API' (name it anything; this is your bot).
 3. Channel > Basic settings: copy the 'Channel secret'.
 4. Channel > Messaging API: issue the 'Channel access token (long-lived)' and copy it.
 5. Turn OFF 'Auto-reply messages' and 'Greeting messages' in the LINE Official Account Manager.
 6. Messaging API > Webhook URL: your public URL + /webhook/line, press Verify, turn 'Use webhook' ON.
 7. Optional LIFF (console inside LINE): create a LINE Login channel > LIFF > add app, endpoint = your public URL + /console, scope openid, copy the LIFF ID.
Full guide with screenshots: docs/LINE_SETUP.md
